name: realtokencost
description: Shows what submitting your current context costs before you send it, tracks whether the prompt cache is still alive, rings a cash register when money moves and warns as the window fills. Chains to any existing statusline instead of replacing it.

interface.displayName: realtokencost — what the context in front of you actually costs
interface.shortDescription: Forward-looking context cost, cache warmth, and spend rings in your statusline
